task.title: View notification event types
task.shortdesc: You can receive notifications for Hybrid Cloud Console events that your Organization Administrator or Notifications administrator configures. You can view the configured events but, unless you are an Organization Administrator or Notifications administrator, you cannot make any changes.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
A Notifications administrator or Organization Administrator has configured behavior groups to receive event notifications.

prereq.note: If you are an Organization Administrator or Notifications administrator, you configure notifications for users in your organization from Settings > Notifications. For detailed information, see .

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud Console, select Settings > Notifications > Configure EventsSettings > Notifications > Configure Events.
Select the OpenShift, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, or Console tab.
To view a list of event types that your Organization Administrator has configured for notifications, select the Configuration tab.
To opt in to notifications for these events, go to Settings > Notifications > Notifications Preferences.
